title: AgentPayProtocolMessage
description: Canonical envelope for all AgentPay Autonomous Economic Protocol v1 messages (INV-171, INV-180)

message_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific message

correlation_id.description: Trace correlation identifier preserving causal lineage

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp. Must be within +/- 300s tolerance (INV-171)

sender_id.description: Agent or Gateway identifier of the message sender

recipient_id.description: Agent or Gateway identifier of the message recipient

message_type.description: Canonical dot-delimited message type (e.g., service.request, protocol.quote)

nonce.description: Cryptographic fresh nonce to prevent replay attacks (INV-170)

signature.description: Cryptographic signature over canonical envelope fields

signature_scheme.description: Signature scheme used to sign the envelope
